stranger_2: ^Your arrival has caused quite the buzz around the town.
^I hope everyone here makes you feel welcomed.
stranger_3: ^Dawn is the best time to be outside.
^The smell of dew and the melody of the birds filling the air.
^Brings a lot of tranquility does it not?
stranger_4: ^I'm sure the day goes by quickly for you.
acquaintance_1: ^Coming from a family of ranchers, the smell of fodder will always remind me of home.
^I may not be too interested in ranching, but my ranching family raised me well.
acquaintance_2: ^What was the literature like on earth?
^I'm sure there were endless amounts of books to read.
^So many exciting stories to be introduced to.
acquaintance_3: ^I always enjoy listening to Arno play his guitar out on the beach.
^The beauty of the instrument mixed with the ocean waves crashing the shore.
^Those are the little moments in life I look forward to.
acquaintance_4: ^I heard your farm is doing well.
^I'd love to come visit sometime if it's no trouble.
friend_1: ^Whenever I'm in a writer's block, I always take a walk around town.
^For some reason, the fresh air always spawns new ideas.
^I guess you're always outside because you're a farmer.
^Maybe I'll come to you for writing ideas.
friend_2: ^Despite my lack of vision, I just adore flowers.
^I hope our town will have a flower garden one day.
friend_3: ^Our friend Jet is such a character.
^He always says "up high", expecting me to high five him.
^But he forgets that I'm blind and can't see where his hand is.
^He then apologizes then assists me to high five him.
^We always have a good laugh about it.
friend_4: ^I hope you are taking care of yourself *player*.
^If you ever need a pick me up, I'll have mom make you her famous veggie soup.
^That always gives me a energy boost.
goodfriend_1: ^Hey *player* would you mind reading a short story I've written?
^I'll have Miya translate from braille for you when she's free.
goodfriend_2: ^Dame and I haven't talked much since his marriage.
^Which is totally understandable now that he's got a bride to take care of.
^I wonder if I'll be a uncle soon.
^I should try and catch up with him soon.
goodfriend_3: ^My grandparents always said that if the clouds had a green tint to them, then hail is coming.
^I could never validate that cause well... you know...
^As a farmer who keeps close attention to the weather, is that theory true?
goodfriend_4: ^How are your farm animals holding up *player*?
^Are you spoiling them as much as my father does?
^Sometimes I think he loves his cattle more than his own children.
bestfriend_1: ^One thing I know I'm missing out on is the ability to see nature in all its beauty.
^If I weren't blind, I think I would become an artist.
^Then again, I guess literature is an art.
^So I'm a artist in my own unique way.
bestfriend_2: ^I can't help but wonder if I'm part of the reason for that.
^He'll never tell me if I am.
bestfriend_3: ^You should learn how to read and write braille sometime.
^That way, we don't have to wait for Miya to translate my writing for you.
^Then maybe you can help Miya with translation.
^I worry that I ask her to translate too much.
^I don't want her to think I'm just using her.
bestfriend_4: ^I'm so glad your ship was the one that arrived late *player*.
^If it arrived on time or never arrived, we would have never met.
^That makes me sad thinking about it.
^But, to my joy, that didn't happen.
^Your friendship brings so much joy to my life.
^Thank you for being so kind to me *player*.
